subject: HeliosAI mid-term capacity top-up and throughput SLA — pricing options
messages:
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@heliosai.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.example
Cc: HeliosAI Procurement <procurement@heliosai.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Request: mid-term GPU top-up + throughput SLOs

Hi Irene,

We’re gearing up for a model refresh and expect a 30-40% bump in inference traffic starting mid-November. Can you share pricing and contract options for a mid-term add to our Dedicated GPU pool? Specifically:

- Cost to add 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs (we currently run a 12 GPU pool) on a month-to-month basis vs reserved for the remainder of the contract (ends 2027-06-30).
- Any throughput guarantees you can commit to (sustained QPS/throughput or tokens/sec) and what credit structure you apply for missed guarantees.
- How billing/proration works for a mid-term change and whether we can stagger the add (2 GPUs immediate + 2 in 8 weeks).

We’ve attached a one-page change request. Procurement will need a line-item quote to evaluate.

Thanks,
Sanjay Patel
VP Engineering, HeliosAI
Sanjay@heliosai.com

Attachment: HeliosAI_Midterm_Change_Request.pdf

From: irene_choi@redwood.example
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@heliosai.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: 2026-10-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: mid-term GPU top-up + throughput SLOs

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the heads-up and the change request. Short answer: we can support both an immediate top-up and a staggered ramp. Below are two pragmatic paths you can take; I’ve captured the billing and SLA trade-offs so procurement can review quickly.

Option A — Short-term top-up (no long-term commit)
- Add 4 GPUs into your existing pool as a temporary top-up.
- Pricing: a month-to-month premium (one-time setup fee + higher monthly rate) — see line items in the attached quote.
- Throughput: best-effort for short-term tops; no formal throughput SLOs guaranteed. For predictable throughput we recommend Option B.

Option B — Reserved mid-term uplift (recommended for predictable ops)
- Convert the 4 GPU add to a reserved commit for the remainder of your contract (prorated to 2027-06-30).
- Pricing: 9–12% discount off month-to-month for a 6-month reserved uplift; 12–15% for a 9–12 month reserved uplift (exact discount depends on final commit size).
- Throughput SLO: we can include a throughput availability SLO (target: 99.5% of provisioned throughput measured at 5-minute granularity). Credits: 5% monthly credit per percentage point below SLO capped at 25% of that month’s committed spend.

Staggered ramp: we can do 2 GPUs now and the rest later — proration pro-rates the reserved portion by day; the top-up portion bills month-to-month until converted.

Next steps:
- If you want to take Option B I’ll draft an amendment and loop legal (I’ve cc’d Karthik for pricing approval).
- I attached a working amendment and a line-item estimate — happy to jump on a quick call to walk through numbers.

Cheers,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.example

Attachment: Redwood_Amendment_Draft_20261002.docx

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.example
To: irene_choi@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: 2026-10-02T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: HeliosAI mid-term capacity pricing — suggested concession

Irene / Marissa — quick pricing note for the quote:

- If HeliosAI converts the 4 GPUs to a reserved uplift for >=9 months we can offer a 12% discount on the uplifted units (we should treat this as a mid-tier concession vs. standard renewal pricing).
- Add a one-time onboarding credit of $6k to offset migration/validation run costs (helps procurement sign-off).
- SLA credit structure: change the initial proposal to a 3-tier credit: 5% credit for 99.0–99.4%, 10% for 98.5–98.9%, 20% for <98.5% — capped at 25% of uplift spend. This provides clearer bands.

I’ll approve the amendment draft once Irene confirms the exact start date and whether they prefer immediate 4 GPUs or 2+2 stagger.

— Karthik
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.example

From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@heliosai.com>
To: irene_choi@redwood.example
Cc: HeliosAI Procurement <procurement@heliosai.com>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: mid-term GPU top-up + throughput SLOs

Thanks Irene — the two options make sense. Procurement has a couple asks before we can sign:

1) Discount: HeliosAI is asking if Redwood can move to 15% on the 9-month uplift (we were hoping for a slightly deeper trade given the short notice and expected usage increase).
2) SLA credits: we prefer a simpler single-rate credit (10% of uplift spend) for any breach to avoid monthly banding complexity — would Redwood accept that with a 99.5% availability SLO?
3) Ramp flexibility: we’d like to start with 2 GPUs now and add the remaining 2 within 6 weeks. Can you confirm no double-billing during the overlap?

If we can get an updated amendment and a DocuSign link with the revised pricing (and the onboarding credit applied), Procurement can review and route internally this week.

Sanjay
VP Engineering, HeliosAI

On Thu, Oct 2, 2026 at 10:05 AM Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.example> wrote:
> Hi Sanjay — thanks for the heads-up and the change request. Short answer: we can support both an immediate top-up and a staggered ramp...

Attachment: HeliosAI_Midterm_Change_Request.pdf

From: irene_choi@redwood.example
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@heliosai.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example, rishi_malhotra@redwood.example, marissa_cole@redwood.example
Date: 2026-10-04T18:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: mid-term GPU top-up + throughput SLOs — proposed compromise

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the clear asks. We discussed internally and propose the following compromise to move this forward quickly: 

- Pricing: 12% discount on the 4-GPU uplift if HeliosAI commits for 9 months (prorated to 2027-06-30). We can stretch to 13% if you sign the amendment within 3 business days. The one-time onboarding credit of $6k will be applied.
- SLA: we will include the 99.5% throughput availability SLO. For simplicity we’ll adopt a single-tier credit of 10% of uplift spend for any breach of 99.5% measured monthly, capped at 20% of uplift spend. (This aligns to Karthik’s intent but gives HeliosAI the single-rate simplicity you asked for.)
- Ramp: we will do 2 GPUs effective 2026-10-15 and add the remaining 2 GPUs within 6 weeks. Billing will pro-rate the reserved portion so you won’t pay double for the same capacity; the interim top-up will be billed month-to-month and then reconciled when the reserved commit takes effect.

I’ve attached an updated amendment draft with the revised pricing and a DocuSign link placeholder. If this is acceptable, I’ll issue the DocuSign and loop Legal to fast-track signatures.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://app.docusign.com/AMENDMENT/HL-2026
Redwood amendment draft: https://app.redwood.example/deals/HL-2026-RNWL-0427 (attached)

If you want the 13% uplift we need a signed amendment by 2026-10-07 (3 business days). Otherwise 12% stands as our standard mid-term uplift concession.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if procurement wants to walk through the amendment.

Best,
Irene Choi
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
irene_choi@redwood.example

Attachment: Redwood_Amendment_Draft_20261004.docx
